problems.quote: OECD‑aligned risk taxonomy — unacceptable, high, limited, minimal
problems.problem: The risk taxonomy with categories unacceptable, high, limited, minimal is from the EU AI Act, not OECD.
problems.correction: EU AI Act‑aligned risk taxonomy — unacceptable, high, limited, minimal
problems.verifierReason: OECD has no such taxonomy; EU AI Act defines those four risk categories.

problems.quote: The proposed AI Ethics Council, under the forthcoming AI Authority Bill
problems.problem: There is no 'AI Authority Bill' forthcoming; the AI Ethics Council is proposed under the National AI Governance Framework.
problems.correction: The proposed AI Ethics Council, under the proposed National AI Governance Framework
problems.verifierReason: No AI Authority Bill exists; AI Ethics Council is under National AI Governance Framework.

problems.quote: National Mission on Quantum Technologies and Applications (NM‑QTA)
problems.problem: The mission approved in 2023 is called the National Quantum Mission (NQM), not NM‑QTA.
problems.verifierReason: 2023 Cabinet approved National Quantum Mission (NQM), not NM‑QTA.

problems.quote: BIS‑approved quantum computing and quantum communication modules inserted into undergraduate physics, computer science, and electrical engineering programmes at centrally funded institutions
problems.problem: BIS does not approve academic curricula; that is done by UGC/AICTE.
problems.correction: UGC/AICTE‑approved quantum computing and quantum communication modules inserted into undergraduate physics, computer science, and electrical engineering programmes at centrally funded institutions
problems.verifierReason: BIS sets standards, not curricula; UGC/AICTE approve academic modules.

problems.quote: Bio‑foundries, designated as Critical Biotechnology Infrastructure under the proposed Biotechnology Regulatory Authority of India (BRAI) Bill
problems.problem: The BRAI Bill (2013) lapsed and is not forthcoming; bio‑foundries are designated under the Bio‑Economy Roadmap 2030.
problems.correction: Bio‑foundries, designated as Critical Biotechnology Infrastructure under the Bio‑Economy Roadmap 2030
problems.verifierReason: BRAI Bill lapsed in 2013; bio‑foundries designated in Bio‑Economy Roadmap 2030.

problems.problem: There is no separate "UAS Rules 2022"; the Drone Rules 2021 (with amendments in 2022 and 2023) govern unmanned aircraft systems.
problems.verifierReason: The 2021 rules are titled 'Drone Rules'; no standalone 'UAS Rules 2022' exists.

problems.problem: The platform is named India Urban Data Exchange (IUDX), not Unified Urban Data Exchange (UUDX).
